key_highlights: ASX closed higher as oil prices and bond yields eased; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) advanced on the day
AUD crushed after hawkish Fed under Warsh; USD strength pressures commodity exporters
IMF urges Australian government to cut spending ahead of a likely RBA rate hike, raising sovereign and state debt concerns
WA exploration pipeline strong: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE, Critica rare earths (58% carbonate), Augustus 30g/t gold, Auric Burbanks plant
Consumer pressure intensifies: Coles holds milk prices, backpacker visa cuts hit farming/tourism, real wages growth crushed by exploited workers
Anthropic secures $31bn datacentre deal in western Queensland, signalling AI infrastructure buildout in Australia
Bathla collapse triggers insolvency storm; private credit exposure to rich-listers flagged as systemic risk
Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports; Middle East oil shock risk elevated amid Trump geopolitical escalation

sectors.trend: Big four banks advanced as bond yields eased; however, looming RBA hike and IMF fiscal warnings create a mixed backdrop. State interest costs soaring.
sectors.implications: Net interest margin tailwind from higher rates offsets credit-risk concerns. Monitor NIM vs. provision cycle. ACCC real estate action may pressure mortgage volumes.

sectors.trend: Active WA exploration: Dalaroo copper-nickel-PGE, Critica rare earths, Augustus gold, Auric Burbanks. Record gold grades at Aguia (Colombia). AUD weakness supports commodity revenue.
sectors.implications: Exploration-stage names (Critica, Augustus, Auric) offer asymmetric upside. BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from AUD softness but face Middle East oil-shock demand risk.

sectors.trend: Fuel supply crunch at east-coast ports; Middle East oil shock risk elevated. Coal policy debate (Albo government) creates regulatory uncertainty. Green hydrogen spend questioned.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDS.AX face input-cost pressure. Coal miners (WDS, LNC) face policy risk. LNG names (WES, BHP) benefit from sustained energy prices.

sectors.trend: Coles (WES.AX) holds milk prices despite removing farmer support; backpacker cuts hit labour supply; real wages growth negative.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CBA.AX (consumer lending) face margin pressure. Consumer discretionary names (WOW.AX, IAG.AX) under pressure from squeezed household budgets.

sectors.trend: Anthropic $31bn QLD datacentre deal; Labor AI regulation (smart glasses ban); News Corp AI content generation. Global AI capex debate (NVDA, Alphabet).
sectors.implications: Australian datacentre/infrastructure plays (VIX.AX, STG.AX) benefit. Regulatory risk for AI hardware. CSL.AX, SVA.AX in healthcare-tech less affected.

sectors.trend: Tenants catching a break (rental relief); ACCC targeting real estate monopoly; Trump policy risk to Aussie house prices.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) may see occupancy/rental pressure. Housing downturn risk from Trump policy spillover.

key_themes: AUD weakness post-hawkish Fed supports commodity exporters but pressures importers and rate-sensitive sectors
RBA rate hike imminent per IMF; state debt sustainability under strain
WA mining exploration pipeline remains a structural positive for ASX materials
Consumer squeeze: real wages negative, labour supply tightening via backpacker cuts
AI infrastructure buildout in Australia (Anthropic QLD) signals long-term capex cycle
Geopolitical oil-shock risk from Middle East/Trump escalation
Insolvency contagion risk (Bathla) and private credit opacity
Regulatory shifts: ACCC real estate, AI rules, immigration policy

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / IMF fiscal pressure
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce leverage; favour banks with strong NIM (CBA.AX, NAB.AX)
Hedge AUD exposure; favour commodity exporters (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) over importers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Middle East oil shock / geopolitical escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hold energy hedges; monitor WES.AX, BHP.AX LNG exposure; reduce consumer discretionary
Screen balance sheets for Bathla-linked exposure; avoid high-yield private credit proxies
Favour staples (WES.AX) over discretionary; monitor retail sales data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing downturn from Trump policy spillover
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and building-product exposure; monitor housing credit data

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX materials on AUD weakness and WA exploration pipeline
opportunities.rationale: AUD crushed post-Fed; Dalaroo, Critica, Augustus, Auric pipeline de-risks future supply; gold grades at Aguia support sector sentiment

opportunities.recommendation: Add to big four banks on NIM expansion from rate hike cycle
opportunities.rationale: Banks advanced today; RBA hike imminent; bond yield easing supports equity valuations
Anthropic $31bn QLD deal signals multi-year capex; domestic AI buildout accelerates

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce consumer discretionary and REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Real wages negative, backpacker cuts tighten labour, ACCC real estate action, Trump housing risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge energy input-cost risk; monitor fuel supply
defensive_moves.rationale: East-coast port supply crunch; Middle East oil shock risk; coal policy uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Screen for Bathla-linked insolvency and private credit exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Insolvency storm triggered; private credit opacity among rich-listers poses systemic risk

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate near recent highs. Bank strength and materials support offset by AUD weakness and rate-hike anxiety. Oil volatility from Middle East is the key swing factor. Expect 1–2% range-bound trading into RBA decision.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural positives: WA mining pipeline, AI infrastructure buildout, bank NIM expansion. Structural risks: fiscal sustainability (IMF), consumer squeeze, housing correction risk. ASX 200 sees modest 3–5% upside over 6–12 months if oil shock is contained.

Middle East oil supply / Trump geopolitical escalation
Coles/WES consumer pricing and retail sales data
Bathla insolvency resolution and contagion scope

RBA cash rate and 10-yr GSB yield
Iron ore, gold, LNG spot prices
ASX 200 bank index vs. materials index rotation
